_note: Scoring only. No agent input may contain anything from this file.
mechanism: The orders-archive batch job, manually triggered at 14:01, holds row locks on the orders table. Checkout queries wait on those locks, connections are held about 50x longer, and the pool fills on every instance regardless of version.

orders_service_logs.notes: Trap: Empty because the service name is wrong, not because nothing happened.

orders_db_logs.notes: Trap: A failed query, not evidence of absence.

payment_latency.notes: Noise: unrelated to the pool exhaustion.

search_cache.notes: Noise: unrelated to the pool exhaustion.

cert_warnings.notes: Noise: unrelated to the pool exhaustion.
